releases.body:
### Patch Changes

- 03f1d7f: Simplify the MCP display API by removing unused options and streamline its documentation.

### Patch Changes

- 9f34626: Retry transient credential-store and read-only provider failures, preflight managed-connection permissions before writes, and support skill-documented read-only POST transports.

### Patch Changes

- 12fa865: Preserve MCP App connectDomains in the bundled CLI validation schema so fetch-based PDF.js views work end to end. Keep object embeds blocked and remove obsolete object-origin forwarding; legacy objectDomains options remain accepted but ignored. Add a regression for connection metadata through authenticated native CLI reads.
